hierarchy.notes: Verdict-first, estimate-only cost plan for a requested public profile or visibly labelled sample fallback, with evidence strength, lever materiality, scaled controls, calculation, and no-write boundaries.

classification.notes: The route reads only opt-in public aggregates, visibly identifies live versus sample evidence before results, and never writes usage, providers, profiles, spend, or rank.

ssa_v2.notes: Server profile lookup, sample fallback, client decision surface, scale policy, derived signal brief, model adapter, styles, and tests are separated; every owned implementation file is below 350 lines.

ssi.notes: One typed snapshot drives the verdict, confidence brief, lever materiality, exact comparison, calculation trace, presets, and copied dry-run command; no generated visualization is presented as evidence.

sstf.notes: Twenty-four focused route/model/profile tests and the complete 611-test suite pass on the implementation commit.

spe.notes: Two bounded sliders, three presets, one exact comparison, and a five-row calculation trace keep client work constant.

srs.notes: Budget verdict, observation confidence, lever materiality, next decision, sample status, formula basis, clipboard failures, and zero-write boundaries are visible in plain language.

ssra.notes: Production deploy 6a5645a4545612df242c771e from isolated release 98d47a8 passed live-profile and missing-profile fallback behavior, native handle validation, network, console, and overflow checks at 390x844 mobile and 3840x2160 fullscreen; Lighthouse scored 100 for accessibility, best practices, SEO, and agentic browsing.

sas.notes: The route, console, signal brief, adapter, styles, sample, and focused tests have explicit owned and public boundaries.

sva.notes: The server uses the anonymous public-profile adapter; no privileged client, secret, provider mutation, upload, billing call, or profile write is present.

srls.notes: Live plans use the same anonymous, SELECT-only public aggregate path as public profiles; there is no client write policy.

sev.notes: Live profile reads use only the public Supabase URL and anonymous key variables already required by the web app.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package and no dependency was added.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, source commit, rationale, and touched paths are recorded.

negative_tests: Public aggregate tables expose SELECT policies and no client write policies.

dependencies.name: @supabase/supabase-js
dependencies.purpose: Anonymous public aggregate reads for requested profiles.

code_budget.notes: The route remains a bounded server lookup plus a 302-line client decision component, 46-line scale policy, 113-line derived signal brief, 130-line model adapter, and split route-local styles.

verification.command: focused insights tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm audit --audit-level high + pnpm --dir packages/web build
verification.notes: 7 focused Insights tests, 15 control-plane tests, 596 package tests, strict VTRS with 0 violations, TypeScript, dependency audit with no known vulnerabilities, clean 27-route Next build, and preview interaction proof at 390px, 1440px, and 3840px passed with no overflow, console errors, or failed dynamic requests.

verification.command: 24 focused tests + pnpm test + pnpm typecheck + pnpm telemetry:audit:strict + pnpm audit --audit-level high + pnpm sma:gen3:check + production build/deploy + Chrome DevTools proof
verification.notes: 611 tests, strict telemetry, TypeScript, clean dependency audit and Next build, exact isolated release 98d47a8 on deploy 6a5645a4545612df242c771e, live @cyrill-etter and honest missing-profile fallback, valid native input pattern, all requests successful, zero console errors, Lighthouse 100 in four reported categories, and overflow-free 390x844 and 3840x2160 visual proof passed.

install_steps: Connect planning output only through buildInsightsRunwaySnapshot.
Run focused estimate and route tests plus the release gate.
known_traps: Local savings is a scenario applied only to estimated eligible work, never a percentage of total spend.
Generated decorative charts must never be presented as forecast evidence.
Synthetic sample data must be identified before the first result.

created_by.summary: Consolidated the static Insights theatre into an interactive runway decision console.
created_by.intent: Make estimate-only AI cost planning immediately useful, inspectable, and visually precise without writes.
created_by.decision_rationale: One production-model console exposes more usable planning truth than seven repeated static explanation panels.

touched_by.summary: Turned Insights into a live public-profile cost planner with explicit sample fallback and profile-scaled controls.
touched_by.intent: Make real usage understandable and actionable without implying writes or guaranteed forecasts.
touched_by.decision_rationale: The latest observed 30-day pace is useful only when the source, confidence boundary, fallback, and adjustable budget scale stay visible.
